deploybot: Alert: hotfix rollout rbld/inference:20260323-hotfix triggered elevated 5xx in eu-west1 (embeddings). Rollout PAUSED. Logs: https://internal.logs/ingest/1719632100 :bangbang:

elaine: Ack. Is this related to the quant kernel we saw in canary yesterday?

mike: Likely. Repro on small load in staging. Narrow to embed shard-04 hitting rare OOM.

sre-oncall: Fetching telemetry now. 15m window shows +2.1% 5xx in eu-west1, p95 +18ms. Heatmap -> shard-04 spikes.

dana: Options: full rollback, regional rollback (eu-west1), or targeted patch + small canary. Product impact if we full rollback is lower latency but could reintroduce other fixes.

elaine: Suggest regional rollback for eu-west1 and evacuate traffic, then push micro-patch to shard-04 and canary at 5%.

mike: On it. Preparing image with kernel disabled for shard-04. ETA ~25m.

sam: I'll draft a short customer-facing advisory once we decide.

sre-oncall: Executing traffic evacuation: ```rbctl traffic shift --service=embeddings --from=eu-west1 --to=global-fallback --percentage=100 --confirm```

deploybot: Action: traffic-shift executed by sre-oncall at 2026-03-23T05:15:00Z. Rollout paused.

dana: Good. @mike when patched, request a manual pin for eu-west1 5% so we can validate.

mike: Pushed rbld/inference:20260323-hotfix.2 (shard-04 kernel off). Requesting pin now.

elaine: Approve 5% canary for eu-west1 if SRE places abort thresholds: embed-5xx > baseline+0.5% sustained 10m -> rollback.

sre-oncall: Confirmed alert and paging rule set. Dash: https://dashboards/internal/embeds-eu-west1

support-bot: Notifying support & product channels: @support-team @product :mega:

deploybot: Pin command recorded: `deploybot pin --image=rbld/inference:20260323-hotfix.2 --scope=eu-west1 --percentage=5 --reason="shard-04 kernel patch"`

dana: +1 from ops. Proceed.

mike: Canary started. Monitoring.

sre-oncall: 10m in, no new 5xx. 20m in, still clean. Will hold to 30m before ramping.

sam: Advisory posted: https://confluence.company/hotfix/20260323-embed-evac (short note + status).

deploybot: Canary steady at 5% for 22m. Awaiting full 30m.

dana: If anything pops, immediate rollback target: rbld/inference:20260320-stable.

mike: 30m reached, metrics green. Initiating ramp to 50% in eu-west1.

deploybot: Ramp command issued. Next check in 15m. :rocket:

elaine: Nice work. We'll do a brief timeline capture after the ramp completes.
